'''Pier AC3''' was a location in the city of [[Mon Ubris]] on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. It was from here that [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Jozzel Moffet|Jozzel]] hired a boat during their search for the [[Yavin Vassilika]].
